description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a pink pillow is in front, with a small stack of light blue bowls near the right side. The left hand stays resting near the center of the bed, while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the top bowl from the stack, lifts it, and sets it down closer to the middle; then the right hand continues unstacking by lifting another bowl and placing it separately to the right, leaving several bowls spread out instead of stacked.
